# Specs — telegram-activation

## REQ-001 — Scheduled jobs can read host secrets

**Statement:** Every systemd unit generated by `scheduler-install.mjs` includes
`EnvironmentFile=-%h/.hermes/.env` in its `[Service]` block.
**Acceptance:** `buildUnits()` output contains the line (unit test); on a host
without the file, units still start (leading `-`).
**Dependencies:** none · **Complexity:** S · **Value:** unlocks tokens for all timers

## REQ-002 — Telegram is the active notification provider

**Statement:** The framework project's `notification.provider` is `telegram`;
`notify.mjs status` reports configured when `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` +
`TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID` are present and warns (not crashes) when absent.
**Acceptance:** `node agents/notify.mjs status` exit 0 in both states; send
no-ops with a clear reason when unconfigured.
**Dependencies:** REQ-001 · **Complexity:** S · **Value:** notifications reach Bryce

## REQ-003 — Best-effort desktop popups

**Statement:** With `notification.desktop: true`, `sendNotification()` also
fires a `notify-send` popup; popup failure never changes the function's return
value or exit code, and absence of `notify-send` is silent.
**Acceptance:** unit test: desktop helper returns false (no throw) when
`notify-send` is unavailable; sendNotification result equals the provider
result regardless of popup outcome.
**Dependencies:** none · **Complexity:** S · **Value:** at-desk visibility

## REQ-004 — Drain completion notifies

**Statement:** `hermes-drain.sh` sends a completion notification (project, rc,
ready count, last log line) through the drained project's own notification
config after every real (non-dry-run) drain, and a notify failure never changes
the drain's exit code.
**Acceptance:** script test: notify invocation present, guarded with `|| true`,
uses `SDLC_PROJECT_DIR="$REPO"`; dry-run path sends nothing.
**Dependencies:** REQ-002 · **Complexity:** S · **Value:** every cycle observable

## REQ-005 — Auto-merge notifies

**Statement:** `pr-auto-review.mjs` sends a notification after a successful
squash-merge (PR number + title); notification failure does not fail the run
or the merge record.
**Acceptance:** unit test: merge path calls the notifier inside try/catch
(source-level assertion consistent with existing pr-auto-review test style);
dry-run does not notify.
**Dependencies:** REQ-002 · **Complexity:** S · **Value:** merges are push events
